artworks.title: Ulysses' Revenge on Penelope's Suitors
artworks.description: Neoclassical daylight on the poem's darkest hour: the beggar in the doorway has already become the archer, and the hall's feast turns to flight.

films.title: Ulysses
films.description: Kirk Douglas' homecoming climax restages the bow contest and the hall's blood — modern cinema's first major Odyssey massacre.

films.title: The Odyssey
films.description: The miniseries keeps the suitors' feast and slaughter as the poem's long-deferred justice.

popCulture.title: Suitors of Penelope
popCulture.description: The hundred-odd wooers remain the Odyssey's emblem of violated hospitality — and of a home reclaimed by the bow.

popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.description: Books XXI–XXII — the contest of the axes and the closing of the doors — still define how Western narrative stages a reckoning.
